# DOM Director

> Draft design for an agent-friendly cinematic walkthrough engine over live applications. Reusable runtime not implemented; separate fixture demo available.

## Read first
- [README](README.md): status and scope
- [Agent agreement](AGENTS.md): implementation constraints and validation
- [Design index](docs/README.md): complete reading map
- [Architecture](docs/04-architecture.md): components and ownership
- [Script format](docs/05-script-format.md): canonical language
- [Playback](docs/07-timeline-and-playback.md): seek/effect separation
- [Agent tools](docs/10-agent-contract.md): discovery, validation, control, repair
- [Security](docs/12-security-and-privacy.md): host permissions and trust
- [Roadmap](docs/16-roadmap.md): bounded implementation order

## Machine-readable contracts
- [Tour schema](schemas/tour.schema.json)
- [Command schema](schemas/agent-command.schema.json)
- [Diagnostic schema](schemas/diagnostic.schema.json)
- [Requirements](docs/requirements.json)
- [Backlog](docs/backlog.json)
- [Examples](examples/README.md)

The demo-local implementation is not a public runtime API. No cloud service, hosted schema endpoint, published npm package, or browser certification is implied.

## Flagship concept
- [Demo design](docs/22-flagship-demo.md): storyboard, real proof moments, and rollout
- [Demo source](demo/README.md): build/run/test and implementation limits
- [Demo evidence](demo/VALIDATION.md): exact local checks and remaining gaps
